Invoice and ledger typing work is complete in `billing/invoices.py`: `LineItem`, `build_invoice_lines`, and `calculate_totals` are annotated, `post_entry` is typed, discounts use `Decimal`, and timestamps are timezone-aware UTC rather than deprecated `datetime.utcnow()`. Billing tests (34), the full suite (96), and `mypy ledgerly/billing` all pass; whitespace and CSV UTF-8 checks are clean. No reconciliation, export timestamp, subscription usage, invoice property, decimal normalization, or payment retry backoff changes were made. Production dual-write still requires approval.

The unresolved credit-after-refund issue remains: `tests/test_invoice_totals.py::test_apply_credit_after_refund` expects `87.50` but receives `90.00`. Investigation points to `CreditMemo.amount` being applied before `refund_total` is deducted in `src/ledgerly/billing/invoices.py::apply_credit`. The broader suite otherwise passed 318 tests with 4 skipped.

Recently, invoice test setup was refactored in `tests/conftest.py`: a `make_invoice` helper was added for configurable invoice creation, an `organization_factory` fixture from `tests/factories.py` replaced 19 repeated organization setup blocks, and a `db_session` rollback fixture was added. `tests/test_invoices.py` passes all 46 tests. There are still 27 direct `Invoice.objects.create` calls across invoice, payment, and report tests that may be candidates for further fixture-based cleanup.
